dataType.title: Data type
dataType.description: Which SAM.gov public dataset to pull. **Contract opportunities** (default) returns solicitations/awards. The three **wage determination** options return the Department of Labor determinations SAM.gov publishes: **Davis-Bacon Act** (construction, ~85k records), **Service Contract Act** (services, ~2.7k) and **Collective Bargaining Agreement** (~108k). Wage-determination modes support the keyword, state, active-only and max-results filters only — NAICS, set-aside, notice type, organization and detail enrichment are opportunity-only and are ignored (with a log warning) if set. They return the determination index (which determination applies to which state/counties, its revision and whether it is current), not the per-occupation hourly rate tables. **Assistance listings (CFDA)** returns the Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance — federal grant/loan/direct-payment programs (~7.4k, ~2.9k currently active) — with objective, eligibility, funding-obligation history and agency contact per program. Supports keyword, organization, active-only and max-results only — NAICS/set-aside/notice-type/state are opportunity-only and ignored here (assistance-listing programs are nationwide, not filtered by place of performance). **Exclusions** returns SAM.gov's federal debarment/suspension list, restricted to organizations only (firms, vessels and special entity designations — ~35.2k records) — it never returns the individual-person exclusion records SAM.gov also publishes, to avoid shipping a people-search product; see the README for detail. Supports keyword (entity name) and organization only — NAICS/set-aside/notice-type/state/active-only are ignored (state is applied server-side but returns zero matches on this index; active-only has no effect on it at all).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Searched against opportunity title/description. For wage determinations it matches the determination's reference number (e.g. "AK20260001"), NOT trades or occupations. For assistance listings it matches title/objective/program number. For exclusions it matches the excluded entity's name. Leave empty for all. Defaults to "contract" for opportunities so a first test run never returns 0 rows; other data types default to empty.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Filter to one or more 6-digit NAICS codes, e.g. 541511.

setAsideTypes.title: Set-aside types
setAsideTypes.description: Filter to SAM.gov set-aside codes, e.g. SBA (total small business).

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Which SAM.gov notice types to include. All types if left empty. The last 4 (m/f/j/l) are legacy codes SAM.gov's own UI dropdown no longer lists and stopped issuing around 2019-2020, but ~97k real historical opportunities still carry them and are otherwise unreachable by this filter -- useful for historical research, not current solicitations.

states.title: Place of performance state(s)
states.description: 2-letter US state codes, e.g. CA. For opportunities this is the place of performance; for wage determinations it is the state the determination covers. Multiple states are OR-ed. Not supported for assistance listings or exclusions (ignored for both).

organizationId.title: Organization ID
organizationId.description: SAM.gov internal organization ID to filter to one agency/office (advanced; find via a search result's organizationHierarchy). Supported for opportunities, assistance listings and exclusions; ignored for wage determinations.

activeOnly.title: Active records only
activeOnly.description: Only return records SAM.gov currently flags active (for wage determinations: currently in force, i.e. not superseded by a later revision; for assistance listings: the program is currently active, ~2.9k of ~7.4k). Has no effect on exclusions — SAM.gov's exclusions index does not support server-side active-status filtering; check each row's own isActive/terminationDate fields instead.

enrichDetail.title: Enrich with detail call
enrichDetail.description: Make one extra request per opportunity to add NAICS codes, set-aside, place-of-performance state/country and point-of-contact (name/email/phone, published by the agency itself as part of the public notice). Slower. Opportunities only; ignored for wage determinations, assistance listings and exclusions (their search rows already carry the full record).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many opportunities. SAM.gov's own search backend caps result depth at 10,000 for any single query — narrow keyword/filters to go deeper.

watchLabel.title: Watch label (only new since last run)
watchLabel.description: Optional. Name a saved search (e.g. "my-naics-541511-watch") and this run returns ONLY opportunities not delivered under that same label and filter set before, instead of the full match set every time. The first run for a label is a free baseline: it records what already matches and returns zero rows. Run it again later — on a schedule, typically — to get only what's new. The baseline is kept in your own Apify account (a named key-value store), keyed by label plus a fingerprint of your other filters, so changing a filter starts a fresh baseline instead of dumping previously-excluded opportunities as "new".

watchChanges.title: Watch mode: also alert on lifecycle/deadline changes
watchChanges.description: Only used together with Watch label. When on, a run also re-delivers a record you already have if its watched fields changed since you last saw it: for opportunities, active/notice-type status (e.g. presolicitation turning into a solicitation, or an award landing), response deadline, modified date, modification count, awardee or description; for wage determinations, revision number, active status or modified date; for assistance listings, active or funded status, modified date, or historical-index entry count; for exclusions, active status or termination date (a debarment being lifted). Charged at the same per-row price as a new record. Each changed row is tagged with `_watchChangeType` (one or more of `isActive`, `noticeTypeCode`, `responseDate`, `modifiedDate`, `modificationsCount`, `awardeeName`, `description`, `revisionNumber`, `isFunded`, `historicalIndexCount`, `terminationDate`) plus the previous value(s) under `_watchPrevious`. Off by default so existing watches keep their current behaviour.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (notify on completion)
webhookUrl.description: Optional. An http(s) URL to POST a small JSON summary to when the run finishes — opportunities pushed, rows scanned, and (when Watch label is set) whether this was a baseline run plus the new/changed/skipped counts, along with the run's dataset ID so you can fetch the results. A convenience for callers who want a completion ping without setting up an Apify platform webhook (which needs separate Console/API configuration per Task, not per run). Best-effort: a failed or slow webhook is logged as a warning and never fails the run or affects charging — it fires after every opportunity has already been pushed and charged. Leave empty to skip.
